connectionSpecification.description: Reads currencies, the latest exchange rates and daily historical rates from Open Exchange Rates.

app_id.description: App ID of your Open Exchange Rates account. It is sent in the Authorization header.
app_id.title: App ID

base.description: Currency the rates are quoted against. Changing it needs a paid plan; empty uses USD.
base.title: Base Currency

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC, whose historical rates are read.
start_date.title: Start Date

symbols.description: Currencies to read rates for; empty reads every currency. Needs a paid plan.
symbols.title: Symbols

connectionSpecification.title: Open Exchange Rates Source Spec
